What is the best beach club on Koh Samui? | It depends on what you want. ARKbar in Chaweng is the best for a big, affordable party, with a daily pool party from 14:00 and a free fire show from 20:00. SEEN at Avani Chaweng is the stylish pool club, Chi Samui and Tembo in Bang Rak are best for sunset DJs, and Nikki Beach in Lipa Noi is the most glamorous.
Which beach clubs on Samui have pool parties? | ARKbar in Chaweng runs a pool party every day from 14:00, peaking from 16:00 to 19:00, with live performers on Wednesday and Friday. SEEN Beach Club at Avani Chaweng held its "SEENturday" pool party on Saturdays in 2025–26. Chi Samui in Bang Rak has a swim-up pool bar. Check the week's programme before you go.
Where is the best Sunday brunch on Koh Samui? | The best-known beach-club brunches are the Sunday brunch at Nikki Beach in Lipa Noi and the family brunch at SEEN Beach Club in Chaweng. Many five-star resorts also run Sunday brunches with free-flow packages. Book ahead from December to April, and expect "++" prices, which add 17.7 % to the menu price.
Do Koh Samui beach clubs charge entry? | Most charge no entry on normal days and make their money from minimum spends on sunbeds and cabanas, from about 300 THB at ARKbar to 5,000 THB or more for a cabana at SEEN. Big events and New Year's Eve can be ticketed: ARKbar's NYE 2025 countdown was free before 21:00 and 500 THB after.
What does "++" mean on Koh Samui prices? | "++" means 10 % service charge and 7 % VAT are added to the listed price, so 1,000++ THB costs 1,177 THB. Resorts, beach clubs and upmarket restaurants use it; street food and small bars quote net prices. Always check whether a minimum spend is "++" too.
Are Koh Samui beach clubs child-friendly? | In the daytime, mostly yes. SEEN's Sunday brunch is aimed at families, and children are welcome at many clubs during the day. Party nights are adults only: ARKbar admits adults only from 21:00, and the legal drinking age in Thailand is 20. Policies vary by event, so check before you go.
~Is Beach Republic in Lamai open? | Largely no. Beach Republic in south Lamai, once known for its pool parties and Sunday brunch, had its pool bar and much of the resort reported closed in 2025–26, with only a small beach café trading. Don't plan around it. For a beach club, head to Chaweng or Bang Rak.
Can you arrive at a Samui beach club by boat? | Sometimes, but it is not straightforward. Most Samui beach clubs have no jetty, the north-coast bays are shallow at low tide, and the east coast has swell from October to December. If you book a private speedboat or catamaran with us, ask about a beach-club stop and we will tell you honestly whether it is possible.
